zh.chart.aria: 本月每日加班时长柱状图

zh.empty.desc: 录入开始和结束时间，自动计算净加班时长
zh.empty.try: 调整日期、类别或搜索关键词，或补录一条记录。
zh.data.title: 本地数据
zh.data.desc: 所有记录留在这部手机，不需要注册或联网。
zh.privacy.title: 离线使用，安心记录
zh.privacy.desc: 应用不申请联网权限，不含广告、统计或第三方服务。已关闭系统自动备份，记录保存在应用私有目录。
zh.backup.title: 导出完整备份
zh.backup.desc: 保存为 JSON 文件，可用于恢复记录
zh.import.title: 导入备份
zh.import.desc: 合并记录，相同编号保留手机当前版本
zh.csv.title: 导出表格
zh.csv.desc: 全部月份导出为 CSV，可用 Excel 打开
zh.notice.title: 请把备份保存在手机本地
zh.notice.desc: 文件选择器中选择“下载”或手机内部存储，请勿选择网盘。卸载、清除应用数据或更换手机前，请先导出备份；本应用没有云端恢复。
zh.rules.title: 统计规则
zh.rules.time: 净加班时长 = 结束时间 − 开始时间 − 休息分钟。结束在第二天时，请勾选“次日”。单条记录最多24小时；已有时间段不能重复记录。
zh.rules.type: 工作日、休息日和节假日由你手动选择，不自动判断调休，也不计算工资。跨月记录全部归入开始日期所在月份。
zh.rules.formats: JSON（JavaScript Object Notation，结构化数据格式）备份可恢复记录；CSV（Comma-Separated Values，逗号分隔值）表格仅供查看，不能用于恢复。
zh.version.label: 加班手记 1.2.0 · 离线版
zh.field.noteHint: 例如：项目调试、临时任务…
zh.discard.title: 放弃本次修改？
zh.discard.desc: 尚未保存的内容会丢失。
zh.delete.title: 删除这条记录？
zh.delete.desc: 删除后无法直接撤销；已导出的备份不受影响。
zh.export.local: 接下来请选择手机“下载”或内部存储，不要选择网盘。
zh.export.backupDesc: JSON 备份包含全部月份记录，可在本应用中导入。

zh.error.breakTooLong: 休息时长必须小于本次总时长

zh.error.overlap: 这段时间与已有记录重叠，请检查日期和时间

zh.stats.comparisonRule: 同期比较按日期截取：本月比到今天，历史月份比整月；上月缺少对应日期时取月末。
zh.trend.title: 加班趋势
zh.trend.aria: 加班时长趋势；可点击数据点筛选明细

zh.template.limit: 最多保存30个模板，请先删除不再使用的模板

en.app.name: Overtime Notes
en.language.title: App language
en.language.desc: Switch to Chinese. Your choice stays on this device.
en.chart.title: Daily overtime
en.chart.aria: Daily overtime chart for this month
en.records.title: Entries
en.records.rule: Entries belong to their start month · Exact to the minute
en.empty.title: Start this month’s time log
en.empty.desc: Add start and end times to calculate net overtime.
en.empty.try: Try a different date, type or keyword, or add an entry.
en.data.title: Local data
en.data.desc: All records stay on this phone. No account or connection needed.
en.privacy.title: Private by design
en.privacy.desc: No internet permission, ads, analytics or third-party services. Automatic backups are disabled. Records are stored in the app’s private folder.
en.backup.title: Export full backup
en.backup.desc: Save a JSON backup to restore your entries later.
en.import.title: Import backup
en.import.desc: Merge entries; existing IDs keep the version on this phone.
en.csv.title: Export spreadsheet
en.csv.desc: Export all months as CSV for Excel or other spreadsheet apps.
en.notice.title: Keep backups on your phone
en.notice.desc: Choose Downloads or internal storage in the file picker, rather than a cloud drive. Export a backup before uninstalling, clearing app data or changing phones. There is no cloud recovery.
en.rules.title: How totals work
en.rules.time: Net overtime = end time − start time − break minutes. Select “Next day” when the entry ends after midnight. Each entry is limited to 24 hours; time ranges cannot overlap.
en.rules.type: Choose Workday, Rest day or Holiday manually. The app does not infer local holiday schedules or calculate pay. Each entry is counted entirely in its start month.
en.rules.formats: JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) backups can restore entries. CSV (Comma-Separated Values) files are spreadsheets for viewing and cannot be imported to restore data.
en.version.label: Overtime Notes 1.2.0 · Offline
en.discard.title: Discard changes?
en.discard.desc: Your unsaved changes will be lost.
en.delete.title: Delete this entry?
en.delete.desc: This cannot be undone. Existing backup files will not be changed.
en.export.csvTitle: Export all entries as a spreadsheet
en.export.local: Choose Downloads or internal storage on your phone, rather than a cloud drive.
en.export.backupDesc: The JSON backup includes all months and can be imported into this app.
en.export.csvDesc: The CSV spreadsheet includes all months for viewing and cannot restore entries.
en.import.confirmDesc: Select a JSON backup exported by this app. Existing IDs and overlapping time ranges are skipped; entries already on this phone take priority.
en.error.appOnly: Please use the installed Android app.
en.error.generic: The operation failed. Your existing records are unchanged. Please try again.
en.error.format: Invalid data format. Check your input or backup file.
en.error.fillTime: Enter a date, start time and end time.
en.error.dateRange: Choose a valid date and time between 2000 and 2100.
en.error.breakInt: Break time must be a whole number of minutes.
en.error.breakPositive: Break time must be a non-negative whole number of minutes.
en.error.endAfter: End time must be later than start time. For overnight entries, select “Ends next day”.
en.error.maxDay: Each entry must be 24 hours or less.
en.error.timeRange: End time must be later than start time, with a maximum duration of 24 hours.
en.error.breakTooLong: Break time must be shorter than the total duration.
en.error.noteLength: Notes can contain up to 500 characters.

en.msg.fileSaved: File saved. Keep it in a safe place.
en.error.fileSave: Could not save the file. Please try again.
en.error.backupSize: The backup exceeds the 64 MB limit.
en.error.backupApp: Choose an original backup exported by Overtime Notes.
en.error.backupCount: A backup can contain up to 10,000 entries.
en.error.backupId: The backup contains an entry with no ID.
en.import.result: Entries imported: {0}. Existing IDs skipped: {1}; overlapping entries skipped: {2}. Existing records were kept.
en.error.import: Import failed. Check the file. Existing records were kept.
en.csv.header: Date,Start time,End time,Next day,Break minutes,Net overtime minutes,Net overtime hours,Type,Note
en.stats.comparisonRule: Comparison uses dates: this month runs through today; historical months use the whole month. The previous period ends on the same day number, capped at its month end.
en.trend.title: Overtime trend
en.trend.aria: Overtime trend. Select a point to filter entries.
en.trend.hint: Select a point for entries. Toggle categories to hide them. Vertical axis: hours.
en.trend.selected: {0}: {1}, {2} entries. The entry list now shows this date range.
en.trend.hiddenHint: Some chart categories are hidden; the list includes all categories in this range.
en.heat.title: Overtime calendar
en.heat.hint: Color shows net time. Select a day to view or add entries. A dot marks an overnight entry.
en.breakdown.title: This month by type
en.filter.title: Date & type filters
en.filter.badRange: The start date must not be after the end date.
en.filter.searchAria: Search notes in the selected date range
en.appearance.title: Appearance & reading
en.appearance.motionHint: Also respects the system reduced-motion setting.
en.error.preferences: Invalid appearance settings. Please choose again.
en.quick.copied: Last time range copied. Check the date and times.
en.quick.changeDate: This is now a new entry. Change its date or times before saving.

en.template.manageHint: Save frequent time ranges in the entry form. Use, rename or delete them here.
en.template.save: Save this time range as a template
en.template.name: Template name
en.template.nameError: Enter a template name of 1–80 characters.

en.template.applied: Template applied. The entry date is unchanged.

en.batch.result: Saved: {0}. Not saved: {1}. See the results for each date.
en.backup.v2Desc: Save entries, trash, templates and appearance settings.
en.backup.exportDesc: The full backup includes all months, trash, templates and appearance settings. It is an unencrypted JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) file. The backup date updates only after a successful file save.
en.import.v2Hint: Preview before merging. Older backups are supported. Current appearance is kept unless you choose to restore it in the preview.
en.import.previewHint: No entries have been written yet. Confirm to merge; existing IDs and overlapping entries are skipped. Current entries take priority.
en.import.extras: The backup also contains {0} templates and {1} trash entries. Duplicates, expired trash and templates above the limit are skipped.

en.language.closePanel: Close the current panel before changing languages.
en.trash.title: Trash
en.trash.hint: Deleted entries are kept for 30 days, then removed automatically.
en.trash.deleteDesc: The entry will move to trash and can be restored for 30 days. Existing backup files are unchanged.
en.trash.permanentDesc: This cannot be undone. Copies in existing backup files will remain.
en.trash.conflict: Cannot restore: an entry with the same ID or an overlapping time range already exists. Resolve the conflict first.
en.import.restoreSettings: Also restore appearance settings and language
